AccurateGroup.description: Advanced condition group. Do not pass this field if advanced conditions are not enabled or the list is empty. If enabled, Logic and at least one valid AccurateRules must be passed.

AccurateGroupPriority.description: Advanced condition group priority. Not required when creating/updating, used only for list display.

AccurateRules.description: List of subrules in advanced conditions

Id.description: Advanced condition group ID. Not required for create/update; used only for list display

HttpObj.description: Match object. Fixed objects are automatically generated as HttpObj by ObjType; custom objects require a specific Key in HttpObj. For example: request.header.clientip, request.uri, request.queryargs.abc, request.header.custom-header, request.cookie.custom-cookie, etc

ObjType.description: Match object type enumeration. 0: Request protocol; 1: Request URI; 2: Request method; 3: Request path; 4: Request parameters; 5: Request headers; 6: User-Agent; 7: Referer; 8: Cookie; 9: Request body length; 10: Request body format; 11: X-Forwarded-For; 12: Client IP; 13: Custom Args; 14: Custom Header; 15: Custom Cookie; 23: JA3 Hash; 25: Session-ID; 26: Client fingerprint.

Opretar.description: Match operator enumeration. 0–5: size comparison; 6–11: substring match; 12–15: set match; 16: regex; 17–21: IP identification (only request.header.clientip or custom objects); 23/24: include/exclude address group; 25/26: include/exclude location; 27: include IP intelligence; 28/29: AS number belongs/does not belong

Property.description: Match attribute type enumeration. 0: Value; 1: StrLen; 2: Size; 3: Keys; 4: Version; 5: IP (only used when Opretar=17–21); 6: Country.

ValueString.description: Match value. For Opretar=17–21 (IP identification), no match content is involved and can be an empty string; for Opretar=23–29, fill in according to the required format (IP address group ID/location code/IP intelligence tag/ASN); for other operators, enter the actual match value

Crontab.description: crontab expression. Recommended format: * <startHour>-<endHour> * * <weekList>, for example * 18-20 * * 1,2,3,4,5.

PathThreshold.description: Total path threshold during the specified period. Range: 1–300000

SingleThreshold.description: Threshold for a single object during this time period. Range: 1–300000.

description: WAF CC protection rule. Restricts requests based on network access IP, session, and other HTTP request objects. When the specified statistical conditions are met, a protection action is triggered

AccurateGroup.description: Advanced condition group. The current path Url and AccurateGroup are in an AND relationship; the rule takes effect only when both are matched. Do not pass this field if not enabled or the list is empty.

CCType.description: Action. 0: Observe; 1: Rate limit; 2: Block; 6: JS challenge; 7: CAPTCHA.

CountTime.description: Statistical time window, unit: seconds. Range: 5–1800.

CronConfs.description: Scheduled activation configuration list. Required only when CronEnable=1.

CronEnable.description: Scheduled activation switch. 0: Off (default); 1: On. If enabled, CronConfs must also be configured

CustomResponsePageID.description: Custom response page ID. An empty string means not configured.

ExemptionTime.description: Exemption time for CAPTCHA or JS challenge. Unit: seconds. Range: 1–3600

Field.description: Statistical object. Supports single or multiple fields, separated by commas. Up to 10 fields allowed. Basic format is DataType:Value, for example HEADER:Authorization, COOKIE:PHPSESSID, ARGS:device_id, CLIENTIP, JA3HASH, SESSION-ID, FP.

Host.description: Domain name. The website domain to protect. Make sure the domain has been added to the current WAF instance before calling

Name.description: Rule name. Must start with a Chinese character, letter, or number. Allows Chinese characters, letters, numbers, English period (.), underscore (_), and hyphen (-). Length: 1–128 characters.

PathThreshold.description: Overall threshold for the current path. Range: 1–300000, unit: times

ProjectName.description: Project name, which is the project associated with the current resource. Only projects with permissions under the current identity can be associated

RulePriority.description: Rule priority. Range: 0–9, where 0 is the highest priority

RuleTag.description: Rule display ID. The RuleTag prefix for CC rules is always E, for example E000000003624

SingleThreshold.description: Threshold for a single statistical object. Range: 1–300000, unit: times.

Url.description: URL match path. Supports wildcards * and ?, where * matches zero or more characters and ? matches a single character. When AccurateGroup exists, Url and AccurateGroup are in an AND relationship.

WSCdnByteThreshold.description: Websocket traffic threshold. Unit specified by WSCdnUnit. Required only when WSCdnEnable=1

WSCdnEnable.description: Websocket traffic statistics switch. 0: Off (default); 1: On. If enabled, WSCdnByteThreshold/WSCdnFrameThreshold/WSCdnUnit must also be configured

WSCdnFrameThreshold.description: Websocket connection frame threshold. Required only when WSCdnEnable=1.

WSCdnUnit.description: Websocket traffic threshold unit. KB: kilobytes; MB: megabytes. Required only when WSCdnEnable=1
